text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-san... could it be that you're 
feeling exhausted...?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
If chocolate is alright... shall I go get 
some? It might help you feel a bit better.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
People might think it's just a treat, 
but... Chocolate is... truly incredible...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
With just a single sip, sweetness 
permeates the entire body... quenching 
thirst... and fulfilling the deepest 
corners of the heart.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Like finding something you've been 
searching for... Like meeting your 
destined one, a pure sense of euphoria—

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Just saying... It would be wonderful if 
you could feel fulfilled too, Trainer.
